priorities.summary: A firmware signature verification flaw in Qihoo 360 routers (D621-2, D603-2, D600-2, D619, D606-6 and D706 up to 6.4.9) allows improper verification of cryptographic signatures, rated the maximum CVSS 10.0. Affected devices should be updated to fixed firmware or replaced if no fix is available.

A path traversal flaw in Termix-SSH Termix up to 2.9.2 lets a remote attacker manipulate the destPath argument of the file-manager transferToHost endpoint, with a public exploit available. Update Termix beyond 2.9.2 and restrict access to the file-manager API.

The Ruby on Rails Active Storage gem before 8.1.4.1 can allow server read and write operations, such as reading secret_key_base, when ImageMagick attachment processing runs without a security policy blocking unintended functionality. Published November 4; upgrade Active Storage to the fixed release.

model.name: Tencent Hy4
model.summary: Tencent launched the full Hy4 model on November 4, a 770-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model that adds native visual understanding and computer-use abilities to the Hunyuan line for the first time. It can read images and operate software via command-line and graphical interfaces, and is live through Tencent Cloud TokenHub, OpenRouter and Tencent's own apps, with open weights promised soon.
